runbook.statementMd: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to `target`. Exactly one solution exists and you may not use the same element twice.

solutionTracks.name: Brute force
probes: What is the cost of the inner loop as the array grows?

solutionTracks.name: Hash map
solutionTracks.approach: One pass; store each value's index and look up target minus current.
probes: What do you trade for the speed?

passed: Walk me through your approach on a small example.
What is the time complexity, and where does it come from?
partial: Which kind of input do you think your code fails on, and why?
failed: Where do you think the time limit or the wrong answer comes from?

hintLadder.text: Think about what work you repeat for every element.
What could you remember about the numbers you have already seen?

rubric.text: Identified the quadratic bottleneck in their own code
Stated time and space complexity correctly
